items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I know Fat Girl – what was his name? –

ctx.x: I’m pretty sure he died after Bird, because I’ve got some records that he made, and Bird was already – not that long after, though, like just around in the same period.
I know Fat Girl – what was his name? –
Fats Navarro. There’s another bad cat.
